calls.title: SDK Connection Design Walkthrough
calls.summary: The team discussed the need to standardize UI elements to improve clarity across the product. Key changes included establishing a primary and secondary badge system for status indicators, which involves clarifying user focus on live statuses and reducing visual clutter. Metadata formatting was also standardized, dictating the use of predefined styles for various status types. Emphasis was placed on using atomic library components for design integrity, and a preference for simpler layouts in panels was recommended. Updates were made to the SDK and experiment pages to ensure a consistent design, particularly in how statuses and revisions are displayed. The importance of backlog management and cross-team communication was highlighted to sustain design consistency, alongside an urgent focus on resolving pagination and metadata issues.
calls.keywords: SDK Page, Badge Design, Metadata, Revision Status, Atomic Design System, Pagination
